description: Scenario: maintainer adds a new SessionContext construction site or reorders a call. session/context.rs::new(peer_addr, auth_required, posting_allowed, tls_active) has three consecutive bool parameters. Rust has no named-argument syntax; a swap of any two bools silently compiles. All three call sites in lifecycle.rs pass these in the same order today, but there is no compiler check. A swap of auth_required and tls_active would allow unauthenticated access when TLS is required.
title: SessionContext::new has three adjacent bool parameters — call-site confusion risk
